title: In silico exploration and molecular dynamics of deleterious SNPs on the human TERF1 protein triggering male infertility.
authors: Harmak, Houda; Redouane, Salaheddine; Charoute, Hicham; Aniq Filali, Ouafaa; Barakat, Abdelhamid; Rouba, Hassan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算预测和分子动力学模拟研究TERF1蛋白有害SNP对TERB1互作的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白TERF1，但核心是SNP致病性评估而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: By limiting chromosome erosion and end-to-end fusions, telomere integrity is critical for chromosome stability and cell survival. During mitotic cycles or due to environmental stresses, telomeres become progressively shorter and dysfunctional, thus triggering cellular senescence, genomic instability and cell death. To avoid such consequences, the telomerase action, as well as the Shelterin and CST complexes, assure the telomere's protection. Telomeric repeat binding factor 1 (TERF1), which is one of the primary components of the Shelterin complex, binds directly to the telomere and controls its length and function by regulating the telomerase activity. Several reports about TERF1 gene variations have been associated with different diseases, and some of them have linked these variations to male infertility. Hence, this paper can be advantageous to investigate the association between the missense variants of the TERF1 gene and the susceptibility to male infertility. The stepwise prediction of SNPs pathogenicity followed in this study was based on stability and conservation analysis, post-translational modification, secondary structure, functional interaction prediction, binding energy evaluation and finally molecular dynamic simulation. Prediction matching among the tools revealed that out of 18 SNPs, only four (rs1486407144, rs1259659354, rs1257022048 and rs1320180267) were predicted as the most damaging and highly deleterious SNPs affecting the TERF1 protein and its molecular dynamics when interacting with the TERB1 protein by influencing the function, structural stability, flexibility and compaction of the overall complex. Interestingly, these polymorphisms should be considered during genetic screening so they can be used effectively as genetic biomarkers for male infertility diagnosis.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 通过限制染色体末端侵蚀和端到端融合，端粒完整性对染色体稳定性和细胞存活至关重要。在有丝分裂周期中或由于环境胁迫，端粒逐渐缩短并功能失调，从而触发细胞衰老、基因组不稳定性和细胞死亡。为避免这些后果，端粒酶作用以及Shelterin和CST复合物确保端粒的保护。端粒重复结合因子1（TERF1）是Shelterin复合物的主要组成部分之一，直接结合端粒，并通过调节端粒酶活性来控制其长度和功能。关于TERF1基因变异的若干报告已与不同疾病相关联，其中一些将这些变异与男性不育联系起来。因此，本文有助于研究TERF1基因错义变异与男性不育易感性之间的关联。本研究遵循的SNP致病性逐步预测基于稳定性和保守性分析、翻译后修饰、二级结构、功能相互作用预测、结合能评估以及最终的分子动力学模拟。工具间的预测匹配显示，在18个SNP中，仅四个（rs1486407144、rs1259659354、rs1257022048和rs1320180267）被预测为最具损害性和高度有害的SNP，它们通过影响TERF1蛋白与TERB1蛋白相互作用时的功能、结构稳定性、灵活性和整体复合物的紧密度，从而影响TERF1蛋白及其分子动力学。有趣的是，这些多态性应在遗传筛查中予以考虑，以便有效用作男性不育诊断的遗传生物标志物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
